description:
Buy Spore Wellness Macrodosing Mushroom Capsules

What are Spore Wellness Macrodosing Mushroom Capsules. Spore Wellness Reset is ideal for those looking for a full magic mushroom experience to give your mind a reset. A single, full-dose of magic mushrooms have shown in studies to produce substantial and enduring decreases in depressive mood and anxiety with increases in quality of life and positive outlooks.

Spore Wellness Reset is a new macrodose product designed to provide an easier alternative to consuming dried magic mushrooms. Chewing through dried magic mushrooms can be an unpleasant experience and dosing the correct amount to take is often difficult. Spore Wellness Reset allows you to take precise doses of psilocybin mushrooms (Golden Teachers or Penis Envy) with added ginger to ease your stomach.

Do spore wellness capsules work?

why not? The Spore Wellness (Reset) Macrodosing Mushroom Capsules (Choose from 5 Strains) works really well.

Now you can choose between five of our most popular magic mushrooms strains: Golden Teachers (our most popular strain), Penis Envy (our most potent strain), Blue Meanie, African Transkei and Albino A+. Expect Penis Envy to be nearly double the potency, we do not recommend it for first-time users.

Each package of SWR contains 12 capsules (500mg per capsule). All Spore Wellness products are Vegan and Gluten Free.

Recommended Use: Promotes mental reset by the means of a full magic mushroom experience.

Recommend Dose:

• Relax: 1 capsule – Mini dose

• Renew: 3 capsules – Museum dose

• Reset: 6 capsules – Moderate dose

Spore wellness macrodosing guide

Benefits of Macrodosing: Psychoactive experience, Combats depression, Reduces anxiety, Mystical and profound experience, Improved neuroplasticity, Reduction of cluster headaches, Reduced symptoms of obsessive-compulsive disorder, and Reduced symptoms of addictive behaviour (narcotics, nicotine, and more).
